text.zh-TW: 實際內容、門檻與期限以 Binance 官方公告為準。
text.en: Details, requirements and deadlines follow Binance's official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」，或用手機掃描 QR Code 開啟 Binance 註冊頁。
steps.en: Select “Sign up”, or scan the QR code with your phone to open the Binance sign-up page.

steps.zh-TW: 確認註冊頁的推薦碼欄位已帶入 37477679；若沒有，請手動貼上。
steps.en: Check that the referral field shows 37477679; if it does not, paste it in.

steps.zh-TW: 完成電子郵件或手機驗證，並依平台規定完成身分驗證。
steps.en: Verify your email or phone number, then complete identity verification as the platform requires.

intro.zh-TW: 立即註冊。展開您的加密之旅。
intro.en: Sign up now and start your crypto journey.

description.zh-TW: Binance（幣安）是提供現貨、衍生品等服務的加密資產交易平台。透過下方邀請連結註冊，註冊頁通常會自動帶入邀請碼 37477679；若未帶入，請手動貼上。實際優惠內容與期限以 Binance 官方公告為準。
description.en: Binance is a crypto-asset trading platform offering spot, derivatives and other services. Sign up through the referral link below. The sign-up page usually pre-fills referral code 37477679; if it does not, paste it in manually. Actual rewards and their terms are defined by Binance's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 加密資產價格波動大，投資前請自行評估風險。部分地區可能無法使用此平台，請先確認所在地法規。
notes.en: Crypto-asset prices are volatile, so assess the risks yourself. The platform may be unavailable in some regions; check your local regulations first.

q.zh-TW: Binance 幣安邀請碼是多少？
q.en: What is the Binance referral code?

a.zh-TW: Binance（幣安）邀請碼為 37477679，也可以直接使用本頁的邀請連結註冊。
a.en: The Binance referral code is 37477679. You can also sign up directly with the referral link on this page.

q.en: Where do I enter the referral code?

a.zh-TW: 在註冊表單的推薦碼欄位輸入；使用邀請連結時通常會自動帶入。
a.en: Enter it in the referral field of the sign-up form. It is usually pre-filled when you use the referral link.
